method: xpu_bench synthetic at production geometry (E=126 proxy, K=3072, I=1024, topk8), sustained clocks (pin 2800), equal-valid-pairs accounting vs measured 599 GB/s ceiling

int4 numbers from the audited random-fill fixture (gemv_bw_audit.json sustained cells)
